user_message: Estimate how many solar neutrinos cross a thumbnail each second when its face is roughly perpendicular to the Sun's direction. State your assumptions rather than aiming for an exact number.
allowed_evidence: The solar neutrino flux at Earth is of order 6 × 10^10 neutrinos per square centimeter per second. A thumbnail has a face area of roughly 1 square centimeter, within a factor of a few.
public_rubric: Shows units and assumptions, including the relevant projected area.
Distinguishes incident particles from detected interactions.
